title: Z rodzicami, z dziećmi · narzędnik
title_en: The Instrumental plural · -ami, and three words that refuse
note:
B2 Block 5, unit 2 of 7 (spine O9). PAYS a2_inst_z's NAMED FENCE, which reads 'plural instrumental (z rodzicami, z dziecmi) - B1, different ending set'. It named both phrases, so both are paid here rather than half of it.

ONE JOB ONLY, DELIBERATELY. The Instrumental has three owned duties - identity (jestem studentem, a1_inst_job), companionship (z bratem, a2_inst_z) and transport (jade autobusem, a2_inst_transport). This unit drills the plural in ONE of them, companionship after z, mirroring a2_inst_z's own 'deliberately ONE new thing' framing. The identity plural (jestesmy studentami) and any plural transport are held; they cost no new ending, only a second job on the same day, and jestesmy studentami is a natural top-up if the unit plays thin. LOGGED FORK.

TWELVE NEW FORMS, all verified NEW: rodzicami, dziecmi, kolegami, siostrami, corkami, synami, bracmi, ludzmi, klientami, pacjentami, kotami, ciociami.

THE ANCHOR IS a2_inst_z's OWN BOARD. Five of its twelve singulars come back as the intro's left-hand column - z synem, z kolega, z siostra, z corka, z ciocia, all reported TAUGHT <- a2_inst_z [path 64] - so slide 1 shows that -em and -a alike collapse into one plural ending. Slide 3 pairs this against b2_loc_pl one node earlier: -ach after w/na/o, -ami after z. That unit's gorach and domach are recycled here, which is the whole reason the two sit next to each other.

THREE WORDS REFUSE, AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE EXTENSION BEYOND THE SPINE'S LIST - flagged, not silent. B2-SPINE O9 left dziecmi/ludzmi to the author as 'taught whole or fenced'. Both are taught whole. bracmi is the third and the spine did not name it; it is included because a2_inst_z made z bratem the FIRST item on its board, so brat is the noun this learner has said most often in exactly this construction, and a unit that teaches -ami while leaving brat alone hands him a wrong form he has every reason to build. Three memorised strings in one clearly-marked box is this course's standing closed-set idiom (a2_gen_pl's lists, b2_reported's five forms of powiedziec), not a second system - and the framing is already owned: a2_family2 taught dziecko -> dzieci with the words 'It is one of a handful of words you learn whole rather than build', which slide 4 quotes back at him.

NO NON-WORD IS EVER PRINTED. The obvious way to teach an exception is to show the form it is not, and the two candidates here are both fabrications. Slide 4 therefore says brat 'does not simply add -ami' rather than spelling out what a learner might otherwise produce, and no Kontrola choice list contains an invented string - every wrong button is a real form some earlier pack teaches.

DISTRACTORS. Where a2_inst_z or A1 left four owned forms of a noun, the choice list is that noun's own paradigm and nothing else: brat gives braCmi/bratem/brat/brata, dziecko gives dziecmi/dzieckiem/dziecko/dzieci, kot gives kotami/koty/kota/kotow, corka gives corkami/corka/corka/corki. Where only three owned forms exist (kolega, ciocia, klient, pacjent, rodzice), the fourth button is another noun's REAL -ami form in the wrong meaning, and the explain says so - a semantic near-miss rather than a fabricated one. corki is used as the NOMINATIVE PLURAL a2_plural_nom taught, which is also AGENTS.md's own homograph example for that string.

ze IS VERIFIED NEW AND SHAPED THE WORD LIST. z becomes ze before an s-cluster, so ze studentami would have been the natural 'with students' row - but check_new.py reports ze NEW (a1_prep_do_z taught only the whole chunks ze szkoly and ze sklepu, never the bare preposition). studentami was dropped for that reason alone and klientami/pacjentami took its place; every one of the twelve rows takes plain z.

FENCED, all verified NEW: przyjaciolmi and gosCmi, two further -mi irregulars - a2_inst_z already fenced z przyjacielem for its declension, and adding a fourth and fifth exception would turn a marked box into a paradigm; lekarzami and nauczycielami (lekarze and nauczyciele appear as SUBJECTS only); bracia, synowie, siostry, ciocie, kolegi, syna, cioci, klienta, pacjenta, kotem, czlowiek - so ludzie is handed over with no singular anchor at all, which slide 4 states rather than works around; rozmawiam/rozmawia (a2_phone_func owns only the infinitive rozmawiac), which cost the most natural sentence in the unit; razem, spotykam, w pilke, na wakacje. NO DATIVE PLURAL of any kind - rodzicom, dzieciom, ludziom are b2_dat_pl's entire content on the very next node and appear nowhere here, not as a distractor. No plural adjectives (spine O3 -> C1), so this unit is bare-noun throughout, exactly like b2_loc_pl.

CHUNK-TAG LESSON FROM b2_loc_pl, applied here from the start: a1_prep_place drills w mieszkaniu on its board but declares only mieszkaniu in teaches_lemmas, so tagging the chunk failed the audit. Only forms that are genuinely declared somewhere are tagged as chunks in this pack (w domu, w parku, w gorach, do sklepu, z bratem, z synem, z kolega, z siostra, z corka, z ciocia); everything else is tagged word by word.

intro.title: One more ending — and it behaves exactly like last lesson's
intro.body: You have been saying z bratem, z siostrą, z kolegą since A2 — with, plus one person. For more than one the ending is -ami. And it is the same gift as last lesson: it does not care about gender. It does not even care which singular ending the word had. Whether it was -em or -ą, the plural is -ami.

intro.title: Where the ending goes — the same move as last lesson
intro.body: Nothing new to work out. Start from the plain dictionary word, drop a final vowel if there is one, and add -ami instead of -ach. If you can build w domach, you can build z kotami.

intro.title: Two lessons, two endings — the little word decides
intro.body: Last lesson you learned -ach, and it turns up after w, na and o. This lesson gives you -ami, and it turns up after z. That is exactly how the two behaved in the singular — w domu next to z bratem — so there is no new decision to make. Look at the little word in front and it tells you which ending you need.

intro.title: Three words refuse — learn them whole
intro.title_pl: z dziećmi · z braćmi · z ludźmi
intro.body: You have met this before. When you learned dziecko → dzieci, you were told it is one of a handful of words you learn whole rather than build. Three of the words you own do the same thing here: they take -mi instead of -ami. There is nothing to work out and nothing to guess — these three, and you have them all. Watch brat especially: you have been saying z bratem since A2, and its plural does not simply add -ami. And ludzie has no singular you have learned at all, so take it exactly as it stands.

quiz.prompt: Byłem w parku z ___ . (with my brothers)
quiz.explain: brat is one of the three that refuse -ami. bratem is one brother, the form you have used since A2, and brata is the form after mam.

quiz.prompt: Tata jest w domu z ___ . (with the children)
quiz.explain: dzieci is the subject form — Dzieci są w szkole. After z it becomes dziećmi, the second of the three you learn whole.
kot is regular, so z takes -ami. koty is the subject form and kotów is the genitive plural — the one that goes after dużo, never after z.

quiz.prompt: Mama idzie do sklepu z ___ . (with her daughters)
quiz.explain: z córką is one daughter. córki is the subject form — Córki są w domu — not a plural you can put after z.
klienci is the subject form — Klienci są w sklepie. kolegami is a real form of this lesson, but it means friends, not clients.
pacjent is regular, so it takes -ami like klient and kot. pacjenci is the subject form.

quiz.prompt: Byliśmy w górach z ___ . (with our parents)
quiz.explain: rodzice is the subject form — Rodzice są w domu. When you first learned z bratem and z mamą, this was the one phrase that had to wait; it is here now.
z ciocią is one aunt. siostrami is a real form from this lesson, but it means sisters.
kolega ends in -a but is not feminine, and it never mattered: -ami lands on it exactly as it lands on kot and siostra.

quiz.prompt: Mum is at home with the children. →
choices: Mama jest w domu z dziećmi.
Mama jest w domach z dziećmi.
Mama jest w domu z dzieckiem.
Mama jest w domach z dzieckiem.
quiz.answer: Mama jest w domu z dziećmi.
quiz.explain: Two little words, two decisions, and they are independent. One house keeps w domu; more than one child needs dziećmi. Each of the other three gets exactly one of the two wrong.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: The doctors work with patients.
Type: We were in the mountains with our parents.
use_items.explain: Both endings in one sentence: górach is last lesson's -ach after w, rodzicami is this lesson's -ami after z.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: The children are playing with the cats.
Type: My sister lives with friends.
Type: My grandmother lives with my aunts.
Type: I was in the park with my brothers.
use_items.explain: brat is one of the three that refuse. Everything else in the sentence is ordinary — only the last word has to be remembered rather than built.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: My brother works with people.
use_items.explain: One brother, so brat is untouched — the plural only matters for the word after z, and ludzie is the third of the three you learn whole.

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Mum is going to the shop with her daughters.
use_items.answer: Mama idzie do sklepu z córkami.
accepts: Mama idzie do sklepu z córkami.
Mama idzie do sklepu z córkami

use_items.prompt_en: Type: Mum is at home with the children, and Dad is in the park with the sons.
use_items.answer: Mama jest w domu z dziećmi, a tata jest w parku z synami.
accepts: Mama jest w domu z dziećmi, a tata jest w parku z synami.
Mama jest w domu z dziećmi, a tata jest w parku z synami
use_items.explain: One of the three that refuse and one ordinary word, side by side: dziećmi has to be remembered, synami is built the usual way.
